premises: A thin, dense, adherent Cr2O3 layer can be formed at the Cr/Zr interface by controlled pre-oxidation.
This interfacial oxide layer acts as a diffusion barrier to reduce Cr-Zr interdiffusion.
Reducing Cr-Zr interdiffusion prevents formation of a low-melting-point eutectic phase.
The barrier remains effective and stable under normal subcritical water and high-temperature steam up to 1300 °C for 100 days.
